manual: Source builds: go.mod needs Go 1.25 and Debian ships 1.24; bin/build sets GOTOOLCHAIN=auto, so go downloads the 1.25 toolchain once (checksum-verified).
Applying a theme writes ~/.config/omarchy/themes/<name>/ and runs omarchy-theme-set; the bar, i3, dunst, terminals and GTK follow colors.toml.
Optional bar/launcher pickers (contrib/quickshell) are not ported yet: they are Wayland layer-shell Quickshell plugins.
